sentences.text: Cooper, a 6-year-old neutered male Labrador Retriever, is on day 46 of 56 of an owner-entered Royal Canin HP hydrolysed soy trial, with chicken on 29 of 154 meals and treats and at least 4 off-list feedings, the last on Jun 27.
Itching was logged on 16 of 43 logged days over at least 35 days, and this is not a test of the diet: Apoquel (doses not logged), NexGard from Jun 5 and Dentastix from Jun 8 overlap the trial.
The owner wrote "flare after the chicken on Sunday" on Jun 18, not tested, with chicken fed daily from Jun 8.
No chicken-free day is recorded since Jun 8, and whether Apoquel was given is unknown.
